key.name: power-mode-ac
key.summary: Power mode to hold while plugged in
key.description: 0 Balanced, 1 Gaming, 2 Creator, 3 Silent, 4 Custom. -1 leaves whatever the firmware chose alone.

key.name: power-mode-battery
key.summary: Power mode to hold on battery
key.description: Same values as power-mode-ac. The EC does not change the mode by itself when the charger is unplugged, so this is a preference rather than a correction; it is what makes the machine drop to a quieter mode on battery without being asked. The mode is lost across suspend either way, which is why the daemon rewrites it on resume. The charge limit needs no equivalent because it survives on its own.

key.name: cpu-boost
key.summary: CPU power preset to hold in Custom mode
key.description: 0 Low, 1 Medium, 2 High. -1 leaves whatever the firmware has. Only acted on in Custom and only while plugged in: measured, the registers hold a value in every mode but move the graphics power limit only in Custom, and not at all on battery.

key.name: gpu-boost
key.summary: Graphics power preset to hold in Custom mode
key.description: Same values as cpu-boost. Measured to move the dGPU power limit between 50, 80 and 100 W in Custom mode on AC.
